newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 4.10 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 4.10 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 4,104,000 lbs of frozen beef products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced May 17:
The latest award under Announcement LS-48, Invitation 022, will be shipped between December 9 and January 3, 1996.
Winning bidders for the reprocessing beef were Aksarben Foods (Omaha NE) 1.47 million lbs, Fresno Meat Co (Fresno CA) 672,000 lbs and Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 294,000 lbs.

Winning bidders for the beef special trim were Aksarben Foods (Omaha NE) 714,000 lbs, Federal Beef Processors (Rapid City SD) 294,000 lbs, Fresno Meat Co (Fresno CA) 252,000 lbs, Star Ranch (Marshalltown, Iowa) 210,000 lbs.
Winning bidders for the 1-pound chubs were Aksarben Foods (Omaha NE) 79,200 lbs, Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 118,800 lbs.
